sloka: एको ऽयं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य परायणमिव स्थितः।एतच्छेषं बलं तस्य किं तिष्ठत हरीश्वराः ।। ६.९०.८ ।।
transliteration: eko 'yaṁ rākṣasendrasya parāyaṇamiva sthitaḥ।etaccheṣaṁ balaṁ tasya kiṁ tiṣṭhata harīśvarāḥ ।। 6.90.8 ।।

translations.english: "Oh Vanara leaders! He (Indrajith) is the only one who is left in the Rakshasa army. Why do you stand idle?"
